surface_mechanism_description: The 'site-selective-decomposition' process in which the decomposition of the alkylgallium on the As-terminated surface is enhanced compared with that on the Ga-terminated surface.
evidence: We have described in previous reports that Ar + laser irradiation induces the selective decomposition of the alkylgallium adsorbed on an As-terminated surface but not on a Ga-terminated surface. We have defined this concept as 'site-selective-decomposition'.
